name: Recordings from medial entorhinal cortex during linear track and open exploration
description: Contributed to the conversion of recordings from the medial entorhinal cortex of mice, from Neuropixels probes during a virtual linear track task and from tetrodes during open field exploration, writing the SpikeGLX recording and LFP interfaces it used for the Neuropixels data.
Resulted in the publication of a total **1.4 TB** of mouse electrophysiology and behavioral data on the NIH data archive.
